summary: GitLab ships emergency patches for a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE spanning twelve years of releases while Amazon reveals PHP2Shell was probed days before its fixes; Splunk, Node.js, Cisco, and Oracle drop major patch bundles as Railway and Onamae disclose cloud compromises and Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise campaign to Storm-0940.
